name: tralalero
description: Work Tralalero cards or complete PR-scoped work plans with atomic progress and review reporting.

interface.longDescription: Connect an AI coding agent to a Tralalero workboard, read each card's work brief and handoff or a PR-scoped plan prompt, verify PASS checklists, and move every grouped card together for customer review.
defaultPrompt: Open my Tralalero workboard and help me complete a customer request.
List the open cards on my Tralalero board and suggest which request to start first.
Read the Tralalero card I paste and summarize what the customer is asking for.
